hed: US Open women’s singles semifinals set for Thursday at Flushing Meadows
dek: The USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center hosts the women’s singles semifinals Thursday as the 2026 US Open moves into its final weekend, Al Jazeera and tournament schedules reported. Top seed Aryna Sabalenka is chasing a third straight New York title; Coco Gauff, Elina Rybakina, and other top seeds remain in the hunt after Jannik Sinner’s earlier men’s withdrawal reshaped the men’s draw. Women’s final is Saturday; men’s final Sunday.

cl.body: Al Jazeera and international tennis desks frame Thursday’s semis as Sabalenka’s bid for a three-peat colliding with home interest in Gauff and a wide-open path after early upsets — drama first, branding second.

cr.body: USTA schedule coverage and U.S. sports desks emphasize the final-weekend TV package — women’s semis Thursday, men’s semis Friday, finals Saturday and Sunday — and Sabalenka’s ranking as the clear favorite while Sinner’s absence reshapes the men’s side.
